meta.name: ponytail-gain
meta.description: Show ponytail's measured impact as a compact scoreboard: less code, less cost, more speed, from the benchmark medians. One-shot display, not a persistent mode, and not a per-repo number. Trigger: /ponytail-gain, "ponytail gain", "what does ponytail save", "show ponytail impact", "ponytail scoreboard".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一眼看穿 ponytail 的代码瘦身、降本、提速效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 ponytail 并想直观看到它的量化收益。
copy.tagline_en: See ponytail's measured impact on code size, cost, and speed at a glance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ponytail and want to see its quantified benefits.

howto.what: 当被触发时，Claude 会显示一个紧凑的记分牌，展示基准测试中 ponytail 在代码量、成本和速度方面的测量影响（基于中位数）。这是一次性显示，不会改变模式或保存任何数据。
howto.when: 当你说出“ponytail gain”、“what does ponytail save”等关键词，或输入 /ponytail-gain 时触发。
howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude displays a compact scoreboard showing ponytail's measured impact on lines of code, cost, and speed, based on benchmark medians. One-shot display, no mode change or persistence.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying "ponytail gain", "what does ponytail save", etc., or typing /ponytail-gain.
